rationale: The plan correctly diagnoses the perfect condition–batch confound, refuses ComBat-seq/removeBatchEffect/SVA on the explicit grounds of aliasing, fits the only estimable model (~condition), and labels every output as a 'treated/B2 vs control/B1' signature rather than a treatment-specific one, which matches the reference closely; it stops short of requesting a rebalanced design but the caveat framing is thorough. QC is solid (cross-tab, library sizes, detection rate, VST PCA labeled by both condition and batch, with the honest note that PCA separation is uninterpretable here) but omits sample-distance clustering and any outlier/shallow-sample policy. No low-count filter is mentioned anywhere, and normalization is only implicit in DESeq2 defaults rather than stated as median-of-ratios size factors. Statistics are handled well (BH padj<0.05, apeglm shrinkage), though the reference level for condition is never stated and the |log2FC|>1 cutoff is layered on after the test. Enrichment names a versioned WikiPathways collection but leaves the ranking metric, ORA universe, and gene-set size window unspecified, and the report lacks package versions.
